annotations.title: Find waste codes outside the UK

description: Find waste codes in the US federal hazardous waste list (RCRA), California, Texas, Australia or Canada from one to three material words or a code. Returns the waste that answers with its note, route and codes (plain name, official wording where published, and what decides each), other wastes it could be as names to ask about, and a link that reopens the same answer on complyonsite.com. For Australia and Canada, give region (a state or province) to narrow to its codes and the shared list. Use ewc_search for the UK. Candidates only, not a classification.

query.description: One to three material words, or codes.

region.description: Australia or Canada only: the state or province slug, such as victoria, new-south-wales, ontario or british-columbia. Omit for every place.

name: waste_code_search

summary.description: The answer, figure or code first.
